name: Teltow (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Teltow (a black eagle between branches on red).
history: Municipal flag of Teltow; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Teltow arms — black eagle on red
